originalCounterpart: Telegraph/Telegraph/TGProfileController.m (mode TGProfileControllerModeSelf; controllerTitle = Settings.Title, updateTable lines 1796-1868, loadView 671-800, heights 2300-2381), plus TGActionMenuItemCell.m, TGVariantMenuItemCell.m, TGButtonMenuItemCell.m, TGInterfaceAssets.mm, en.lproj/Localizable.strings. TGSettingsController.m is the internal debug menu, not this screen.

findings.ours: src/TGSettingsViewController.m:269 sets tableView.backgroundColor = [[TGTheme shared] listBackgroundColour], which is plain [UIColor whiteColor] (TGTheme.m:309-314). Flat white behind every group.
findings.theirs: The settings/profile view background is the tiled pattern SettingsBackground.png; the table itself is clear. TGProfileController.m:686 self.view.backgroundColor = [[TGInterfaceAssets instance] linesBackground]; TGInterfaceAssets.mm:143-152 linesBackground = [UIColor colorWithPatternImage:[UIImage imageNamed:@"SettingsBackground.png"]]. Table: TGProfileController.m:697-700 backgroundColor clear, opaque false, backgroundView nil.
findings.fix: images/SettingsBackground@2x.png is already in the repo and currently only used by TGProfileViewController.m:150. In applyTheme set self.tableView.backgroundColor = [UIColor colorWithPatternImage:[UIImage imageNamed:@"SettingsBackground.png"]] (or clear table + patterned view background), tableView.backgroundView = nil, tableView.opaque = NO.

findings.ours: Every root section carries a caption: "Suggested", "Account", "Settings", "Stories", "Telegram", "Group tools", "Help" (src/TGSettingsViewController.m:1174-1183), rendered as standard UITableViewStyleGrouped headers.
findings.theirs: The 2013 Settings screen has no section captions at all. Sections are created with no title and the header is a fixed 12pt gap (section 0 also 12): TGProfileController.m:2343-2372 heightForHeaderInSection returns 12 / 10 / 28 by tag only, and titleForHeaderInSection is never implemented for this controller. _tableView.sectionHeaderHeight = 0 / sectionFooterHeight = 0 (697-702).
findings.citation: TGProfileController.m:2343-2372, 700-702; updateTable 1796-1868 creates every TGMenuSection without a title
findings.fix: Return nil from titleForHeaderInSection for all root sections and implement heightForHeaderInSection returning 12 (and heightForFooterInSection returning 1 + (retina ? 0.5 : 1.0), per TGProfileController.m:2374-2381).

findings.ours: Rows in the root list carry a left glyph: fillRootCell sets cell.imageView.image = [TGIcons menuGlyphNamed:row[1]] and tints it (src/TGSettingsViewController.m:1396-1397), which also pushes the title right by the image width.
findings.theirs: TGActionMenuItemCell has no image view at all. It is a title label at x=11, y=12, height 20, boldSystemFontOfSize:17, plus a disclosure image view on the right. No icon column existed on any settings row in 2013.
findings.citation: TGActionMenuItemCell.m:29-40 (titleLabel frame (11,12,w-30,20), font boldSystemFontOfSize:17; disclosure at contentWidth - w - 11, y 14)
findings.fix: Drop cell.imageView entirely on the root settings rows; place the title at x=11 with no indent (UITableViewCellStyleValue1/Default with default 11pt inset), keeping boldSystemFontOfSize:17.

findings.ours: Root list is Account (mobile/username/bio) -> Settings (10 rows) -> Stories -> Telegram -> Group tools -> Help -> Log out, with an "Edit" bar button pushing TGEditProfileViewController (src/TGSettingsViewController.m:253-259, 1119-1133, 1335-1376).
findings.theirs: Root list is: [Set Profile Photo] grey button section; [Notifications and Sounds, Blocked Users, Chat Settings]; [wallpapers strip]; [Ask a Question, Save Incoming Photos, help comment]; and the Log Out red button only while editing.
findings.fix: Reorder the root list to match: put Notifications and Sounds, Blocked Users, Chat Settings first as one three-row group; keep the modern-only sections after it rather than interleaved, and move "Ask a Question" and the save-photos switch into a single trailing group as in the original.

findings.ours: A "Log out" red button row is always present as the last root section (src/TGSettingsViewController.m:1053, 1285-1286, 1446-1492).
findings.theirs: The logout section is added to the section list only when the table is in editing mode; in normal browsing the screen has no Log Out row: `if (_tableView.isEditing) [_sectionList addObject:_logoutSection];`
findings.fix: Only emit the logout section while the controller is in editing state (behind the Edit/Done bar button), matching the original's Edit-mode-only reveal.

findings.ours: Button title is "Log out" (src/TGSettingsViewController.m:1466, and again at 1407).
findings.fix: Change both occurrences of @"Log out" to @"Log Out".

findings.ours: The value on a settings row (e.g. the Chat List variant, notification variants) is drawn in cellDetailColour = rgb(0x51,0xAE,0xE7) at systemFontOfSize:15 (src/TGSettingsViewController.m:1304, 1400-1401; TGTheme.m:226, 341-346).
findings.theirs: TGVariantMenuItemCell's variant label is UIColorRGB(0x356596), systemFontOfSize:16, right-aligned, frame y = 11 + retinaPixel, height 20, right edge inset 11+14.
findings.fix: Set the detail label to UIColorRGB(0x356596) and [UIFont systemFontOfSize:16]; correct TGTheme.m:226 TG_BLUE_SEMI8 (0x51AEE7) for this use - it is an iOS 7 blue that does not appear in the 2013 source.

findings.ours: Standard grouped-table separators are used: applyTheme sets tableView.separatorColor (src/TGSettingsViewController.m:270) and cells keep the default separator style; groups are drawn by UIKit.
findings.theirs: separatorStyle is UITableViewCellSeparatorStyleNone and each cell's group position is painted with stretchable PNGs - GroupedCellTop/Middle/Bottom/Single and their _Selected variants - assigned to backgroundView/selectedBackgroundView.
findings.citation: TGProfileController.m:699 (separatorStyle none); TGSettingsController.m:262-297 (groupedCellTop/Middle/Bottom/Single assignment); TGInterfaceAssets.mm:635-653 (GroupedCellTop.png, GroupedCellTop_Selected.png with capInsets 5,13,6)
findings.fix: Set separatorStyle = UITableViewCellSeparatorStyleNone and give each cell a stretchable GroupedCell{Top,Middle,Bottom,Single}.png background plus the _Selected highlight. Note: those PNGs are not yet in images/ - they must be pulled from the original bundle before this can be applied.

findings.ours: No first-section top gap and no bottom inset are set; the table starts flush under the 86pt header and the grouped default footer runs (src/TGSettingsViewController.m:394, 476-481).
findings.theirs: Explicit bottom table inset of 7pt, sectionHeaderHeight/sectionFooterHeight zeroed and replaced with an explicit 12pt gap above each section and a 1pt (1.5 non-retina) footer.
findings.fix: Set tableView.contentInset bottom to 7, sectionHeaderHeight/sectionFooterHeight to 0, and return 12 / (1 + retinaPixel) from the header/footer height delegates.

findings.ours: The Camera Roll setting is a whole sub-page titled "Save to Camera Roll" (src/TGSettingsViewController.m:233) reached from elsewhere; the root screen has no such switch.
findings.theirs: A single switch row "Save Incoming Photos" sits in the last root group with the comment "Save incoming photos to the Camera Roll" directly under it.
findings.fix: Add a "Save Incoming Photos" TGSwitchItem-equivalent row to the last root group with the footer comment "Save incoming photos to the Camera Roll", keeping the richer per-scope page reachable behind it.

findings.ours: No wallpaper picker on the root screen; wallpaper lives three taps deep under Chat Settings (src/TGSettingsViewController.m:234, 1046).
findings.theirs: The root Settings screen contains a dedicated wallpapers section holding a single TGWallpapersMenuItem row 182pt tall - a horizontally scrolling strip of wallpaper thumbnails.
findings.fix: Add a single-row section between the general group and the last group whose cell is 182pt tall and hosts a horizontal thumbnail strip (builtin-wallpaper-*-thumbnail.jpg are already in images/).

findings.ours: There is no "Set Profile Photo" affordance on the root screen; changing the photo is behind the Edit bar button and TGEditProfileViewController (src/TGSettingsViewController.m:253-266).
findings.theirs: The first section of the root Settings screen is a grey full-width button titled "Set Profile Photo" - TGButtonMenuItemSubtypeGrayButton, frame (9, 0, width-18, 45), boldSystemFontOfSize:17, title colour 0x4a6587, shadow white 0.45 at (0,1), background MenuGrayButton.png stretched from the centre.
findings.fix: Add a first section with one 45pt row containing that grey button (the logoutCellInTable code at src/TGSettingsViewController.m:1446-1492 is the exact template; swap MenuRedButton.png for MenuGrayButton.png, title colour 0x4a6587, shadow UIColorRGBA(0xffffff, 0.45) offset (0, 1)). MenuGrayButton.png is not yet in images/.

findings.ours: Footer under the logout section reads "iTgLegacy <version> (<build>) armv7" in systemFontOfSize:14, 40pt tall, centred (src/TGSettingsViewController.m:455-481).
findings.theirs: The 2013 Settings screen has no version footer; footers are a 1pt hairline only.
findings.citation: TGProfileController.m:2374-2381 (heightForFooterInSection returns 1 + retinaPixel for every section)
findings.fix: Either drop the version footer or move it off the root list; if kept, it should not occupy a 44pt footer slot on a screen whose footers are 1pt.

findings.ours: Suggestion rows are 64pt tall (src/TGSettingsViewController.m:1499-1500), a height that appears nowhere in the original.
findings.theirs: The original's menu row heights are exactly 44 (action/phone/switch/variant), 45 (button), 43 (button strip), 182 (wallpapers) and a measured comment height; nothing is 64.
findings.fix: Suggestions did not exist in 2013, so this only needs to use the original's scale - render the suggestion as a 44pt action row plus a TGCommentMenuItem-style footer comment rather than a bespoke 64pt row.
